machine=imx95-var-dart
kernel_file=Image
initramfs_file=avocado-image-initramfs-imx95-var-dart.cpio.zst
devicetree_file=imx95-var-dart-sonata.dtb
# Space-separated list of .dtbo overlay files on the boot partition, applied
# (in order) on top of devicetree_file at boot. Composed from avocado config by
# avocado-devicetree.service (fw_setenv fdt_overlays). Empty default.
fdt_overlays=

# DART-MX95 debug console is LPUART1 (/dev/ttyLP0) on the Sonata-Board; it is
# the machine's only SERIAL_CONSOLES entry.
console=ttyLP0,115200
# Base device is the SD card: U-Boot mmc 1 / Linux mmcblk1 on the DART-MX95
# (42850000.mmc = eMMC -> mmc 0 / mmcblk0, 42860000.mmc = SD -> mmc 1 /
# mmcblk1; confirmed on the bench against /sys/class/mmc_host). NOTE this is
# the reverse of the i.MX8MP DART, where eMMC is mmc 2. The img/sd provision
# profiles boot from SD with these values; the uuu-emmc profile flashes the
# eMMC and patches devnum/mmcblk to 0 (see stone-provision-uuu-emmc.sh). Do NOT
# set the eMMC values here or SD boot loads from the eMMC instead.
devtype=mmc
devnum=1
mmcblk=1
bootpart=3
rootdev=/dev/mmcblk${mmcblk}p5

# Matches the vendor u-boot env on the board (loadaddr/fdt_addr/initrd_addr);
# i.MX95 DRAM starts at 0x80000000.
image_addr=0x90400000
fdt_addr=0x93000000
fdt_overlay_addr=0x93100000
ramdisk_addr=0x93800000

# Slot A/B only: no recovery partition. An unset or invalid slot boots A.
avocado_boot_init=\
  if test "${avocado_boot_slot}" = "b"; then\
    echo "Booting B";\
    setenv bootpart 4;\
    setenv rootdev /dev/mmcblk${mmcblk}p6;\
  else\
    if test "${avocado_boot_slot}" != "a"; then\
      echo "avocado_boot_slot=${avocado_boot_slot} unset or invalid";\
    fi;\
    echo "Booting A";\
    setenv bootpart 3;\
    setenv rootdev /dev/mmcblk${mmcblk}p5;\
  fi;\
  setenv bootargs audit=0 console=${console} root=${rootdev} rootwait;

load_image=load ${devtype} ${devnum}:${bootpart} ${image_addr} ${kernel_file}
load_devicetree=load ${devtype} ${devnum}:${bootpart} ${fdt_addr} ${devicetree_file}
load_initramfs=load ${devtype} ${devnum}:${bootpart} ${ramdisk_addr} ${initramfs_file}

# Apply each overlay in ${fdt_overlays} onto the loaded base DTB. Needs the base
# built with -@ (symbols) and u-boot CONFIG_OF_LIBFDT_OVERLAY (see avocado.cfg).
# resize gives libfdt headroom for the overlay fragments; a missing/bad overlay
# warns and is skipped rather than aborting the boot.
apply_overlays=\
  fdt addr ${fdt_addr};\
  fdt resize 0x40000;\
  for ov in ${fdt_overlays}; do\
    echo "Applying DT overlay ${ov}";\
    if load ${devtype} ${devnum}:${bootpart} ${fdt_overlay_addr} ${ov}; then\
      fdt apply ${fdt_overlay_addr} || echo "WARN: fdt apply ${ov} failed";\
    else\
      echo "WARN: overlay ${ov} not found on boot partition";\
    fi;\
  done

avocado_boot=booti ${image_addr} ${ramdisk_addr}:${filesize} ${fdt_addr};

bootcmd=run avocado_boot_init load_image load_devicetree apply_overlays load_initramfs avocado_boot
